cards.example_en: I bought a book at the school shop.
cards.example_zh: 我在学校商店买了一本书。

cards.example_en: She ate an apple after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 她午饭后吃了一个苹果。

cards.example_en: She has the ability to solve difficult problems.
cards.example_zh: 她有能力解决困难的问题。

cards.example_en: She is able to finish the science report without any help.
cards.example_zh: 她能够独自完成那份科学报告。

cards.example_en: We talked about our weekend plans.
cards.example_zh: 我们聊了周末的计划。

cards.example_en: The clock is above the classroom door.
cards.example_zh: 时钟在教室门上方。

cards.example_en: My sister is studying abroad this year.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐今年出国留学。

cards.example_en: Tom was absent from school because he was ill.
cards.example_zh: 汤姆因病缺课。

cards.example_en: I am happy to accept your invitation.
cards.example_zh: 我很乐意接受您的邀请。

cards.example_en: A small accident blocked traffic outside our school.
cards.example_zh: 学校门外出了一起小事故，把路堵住了。

cards.example_en: According to the teacher, the test is on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 根据老师的说法，考试在周五。

cards.example_en: Dad checked his bank account after buying the tickets.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸买完票以后查看了银行账户。

cards.example_en: A dull ache in my leg started during the race.
cards.example_zh: 比赛途中，我的腿开始隐隐作痛。

cards.example_en: Hard practice helped her achieve a higher test score.
cards.example_zh: 刻苦练习帮她取得了更高的考试成绩。

cards.example_en: Be careful when you walk across the street.
cards.example_zh: 过马路时要小心。

cards.example_en: We should act quickly when the fire alarm rings.
cards.example_zh: 火警响起的时候，我们应该迅速行动。

cards.example_en: Quick action stopped the fire in the school kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 迅速行动扑灭了学校厨房里的火。

cards.example_en: She takes an active part in the class debate.
cards.example_zh: 她积极参加课堂辩论。

cards.example_en: Our class activity this weekend was a park clean-up.
cards.example_zh: 这个周末，我们班的活动是打扫公园。

cards.example_en: The actor bowed after the school play ended.
cards.example_zh: 校园剧结束时，男演员鞠了一躬。

cards.example_en: The actress forgot her line and laughed with us.
cards.example_zh: 女演员忘了台词，跟着我们一起笑了。

cards.example_en: I actually finished my homework before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我实际上在晚饭前就做完了作业。

cards.example_en: I saw an ad for cheap trainers in the shop window.
cards.example_zh: 我在商店橱窗里看到一则便宜运动鞋的广告。

cards.example_en: Add some salt if the soup tastes too plain.
cards.example_zh: 如果汤太淡，就再加一点盐。

cards.example_en: Remember to address every envelope before you post it.
cards.example_zh: 寄出之前记得给每个信封写上地址。

cards.example_en: I really admire my grandmother for her patience.
cards.example_zh: 我真的很钦佩奶奶的耐心。

cards.example_en: An adult must sit with the young child.
cards.example_zh: 必须有一名成人和小孩坐在一起。

cards.example_en: One advantage of living here is the quiet.
cards.example_zh: 住在这里的一个好处是安静。

cards.example_en: Mom's advice helped me choose a safer bike route.
cards.example_zh: 妈妈的建议帮我选了一条更安全的骑车路线。

cards.example_en: Doctors advise children to sleep eight hours a night.
cards.example_zh: 医生建议孩子们每晚睡八个小时。

cards.example_en: We can't afford a new car this year.
cards.example_zh: 今年我们买不起新车。

cards.example_en: My little brother is afraid of the dark.
cards.example_zh: 我的弟弟害怕黑暗。

cards.example_en: We play football after school every day.
cards.example_zh: 我们每天放学后踢足球。

cards.example_en: We played basketball all afternoon behind the gym.
cards.example_zh: 我们整个下午都在体育馆后面打篮球。

cards.example_en: Please say that new word again more slowly.
cards.example_zh: 请把那个生词再慢一点说一遍。

cards.example_en: Don't lean against the wet wall.
cards.example_zh: 不要靠在湿墙上。

cards.example_en: Children of his age usually ride the school bus.
cards.example_zh: 他这个年龄的孩子通常都坐校车。

cards.example_en: We met two years ago at the school fair.
cards.example_zh: 我们两年前在学校游园会上认识。

cards.example_en: I agree with you about the plan.
cards.example_zh: 我同意您的计划。

cards.example_en: The library is just ahead on the left.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆就在前面左侧。

cards.example_en: Our science class watched a video about AI.
cards.example_zh: 科学课上我们看了一段关于人工智能的视频。

cards.example_en: The clinic sent aid to families who lost their homes.
cards.example_zh: 诊所向失去房子的家庭送去了救助。

cards.example_en: The archers aim their arrows at the red circle.
cards.example_zh: 那些射箭的人把箭瞄准红色的圆心。

cards.example_en: Open a window so fresh air can enter the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 打开一扇窗，让新鲜空气进到厨房里。

cards.example_en: We need to be at the airport by eight.
cards.example_zh: 我们需要在8点前到达机场。

cards.example_en: I was late because the alarm did not ring.
cards.example_zh: 我迟到了，因为闹钟没有响。

cards.example_en: Luckily the goldfish was still alive after the weekend.
cards.example_zh: 幸运的是，那条金鱼过完周末还活着。

cards.example_en: All the students are in the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 所有学生都在教室里。

cards.example_en: My parents don't allow me to play games on school nights.
cards.example_zh: 我父母不允许我在上学日的晚上玩游戏。

cards.example_en: I almost missed the morning bus.
cards.example_zh: 我差点错过早班车。

word.example_en: She will be able to swim after a few lessons.
word.example_zh: 上几节课后，她将能够游泳。

word.example_en: I care about my little brother.
word.example_zh: 我很在意弟弟。

word.example_en: We talk about our weekend in class.
word.example_zh: 我们在课上谈论周末。

word.example_en: Think about the question before you answer.
word.example_zh: 回答前先考虑这个问题。

word.example_en: I am not sure about the answer.
word.example_zh: 我对这个答案没有把握。

word.example_en: My brother is crazy about basketball.
word.example_zh: 我弟弟对篮球着迷。

word.example_en: Above all, bring your student card.
word.example_zh: 最重要的是，带上学生证。

word.example_en: Tom is absent from school because he has a cold.
word.example_zh: 汤姆因感冒缺席，没去上学。

word.example_en: I met my old friend by accident.
word.example_zh: 我偶然遇到了老朋友。

word.example_en: The match stopped on account of the rain.
word.example_zh: 比赛由于下雨停了。

word.example_en: I often come across old photos in this book.
word.example_zh: 我常常在这本书里偶然看到旧照片。

word.example_en: We must take action to save water.
word.example_zh: 我们必须采取行动节约用水。

word.example_en: Her joke will add to the fun of the party.
word.example_zh: 她的笑话会给聚会增添乐趣。

word.example_en: The prices add up to forty yuan.
word.example_zh: 这些价格合计达四十元。

word.example_en: You should take your teacher's advice.
word.example_zh: 你应该听从老师的建议。

word.example_en: My little sister is afraid of the dark.
word.example_zh: 我妹妹害怕黑。

word.example_en: Do not be sad. It is a game after all.
word.example_zh: 别难过，这毕竟只是一场比赛。

word.example_en: I look after my cousin on Saturday.
word.example_zh: 星期六我照顾表弟。

word.example_en: The boy may take after his father.
word.example_zh: 这个男孩可能长得像他父亲。

word.example_en: We play ping-pong after class.
word.example_zh: 我们课后打乒乓球。

word.example_en: Day after day, he practises the violin.
word.example_zh: 他日复一日地练小提琴。

word.example_en: Please say the sentence once again.
word.example_zh: 请把这个句子再说一次。

word.example_en: She read the line again and again.
word.example_zh: 她把那一行读了一遍又一遍。

word.example_en: The child asked the same question over and over again.
word.example_zh: 孩子一遍又一遍地问同一个问题。

word.example_en: She started piano at the age of six.
word.example_zh: 她六岁开始学钢琴。

word.example_en: We agree to the class plan.
word.example_zh: 我们同意这个班级计划。

word.example_en: I agree with you on this point.
word.example_zh: 在这一点上我同意你。

word.example_en: She finished ahead of the others.
word.example_zh: 她比其他人先完成。

word.example_en: Go ahead and ask your question.
word.example_zh: 请吧，问你的问题。

word.example_en: Look ahead and plan your next step.
word.example_zh: 向前看，计划下一步。

word.example_en: They went to Beijing by air.
word.example_zh: 他们乘飞机去了北京。

word.example_en: There are thirty students in all.
word.example_zh: 总共有三十名学生。

word.example_en: There is paint all over his shirt.
word.example_zh: 他衬衫上到处都是颜料。

word.example_en: If you feel all right, we can start.
word.example_zh: 如果你觉得没事，我们可以开始。

word.example_en: My parents allow me to ride to school.
word.example_zh: 父母允许我骑车上学。
